user.title: Energy Joe
user.description: I'm moving in. I'll ask my questions myself – after adding, open **Energy Joe** in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Joe is already set up. You'll find me in the sidebar.

release.name: Release now
release.description: I put back everything I set and stop steering tonight.

replan.name: Plan again
replan.description: I recalculate tonight's plan right away.

skip_tonight.name: Skip tonight
skip_tonight.description: I won't steer the coming night.

answer.name: Answer for tonight
answer.description: In Suggest mode: may I steer tonight?

trigger_action.name: Switch on device tonight
trigger_action.description: Switches on a device that should run at night in the coming night, whatever the forecast says.

release_failed.title: I couldn't put everything back
release_failed.description: These values are not back to where they were: {entities}. I keep trying every five minutes. Check the devices or set the values back by hand.

control_failed.title: Steering failed
control_failed.description: Something went wrong steering {battery} ({code}). I'll leave this battery alone tonight.

no_progress.title: Battery does not charge
no_progress.description: {battery} should charge, but its level has not risen for half an hour. Check whether the battery allows charging from the grid; a test run in the Energy Joe panel under Devices › Batteries helps.

battery_transfer.title: Batteries charge each other
battery_transfer.description: {charging} charges while {discharging} discharges, and it goes on even after I restarted the battery's own control and blocked it for a few seconds. Something else may write the same limits, or a block is not taken. Look at Devices › Batteries › Several batteries in the Energy Joe panel.

not_loaded.message: Energy Joe is not set up.
